type OrdinaryAny<U extends `${U & string}` | any> = U;
type OrdinaryNever<U extends `${U & string}` & never> = U;
type OrdinaryUnknown<U extends `${U & string}` | unknown> = U;
type InferAny<T> = T extends [infer U extends `${U & string}` | any, infer U] ? U : never;
type InferNever<T> = T extends [infer U extends `${U & string}` & never, infer U] ? U : never;
type ArrayTemplate<U extends Array<`${U & string}`>> = U;
type InferArray<T> = T extends [infer U extends Array<`${U & string}`>, infer U] ? U : never;
type ArraySyntax<U extends (U & string)[]> = U;
type TupleMapping<U extends [Uppercase<U & string>]> = U;
type InferTuple<T> = T extends [infer U extends [Uppercase<U & string>], infer U] ? U : never;
type TuplePattern<U extends [U & `key-${string}`]> = U;
type Narrow<T> = T & string;
type AliasArray<U extends Narrow<U>[]> = U;
type Wrapper<T> = {text: T};
type GenericArgument<U extends Wrapper<`${U & string}`>> = U;
type Empty = {};
type EmptyBound<U extends [U & Empty]> = U;
type SelectedBranch<U extends (true extends true ? Array<U & string> | any : {})> = U;
type DeferredBranch<T, U extends (T extends true ? Array<U & string> : {})> = U;

console.log('done');
